questions.question: How does a Current Profile differ from a Target Profile in what it describes?

facts.text: A Current Profile specifies outcomes currently achieved or attempted, and how or to what extent they are achieved.

evidence.quote: Profile specifies the Core outcomes that an organization is currently achieving (or attempting to achieve) and characterizes how or to what extent each outcome is being achieved.

CSF Current Profile A part of an Organizational Profile that specifies the Core outcomes that an organization is currently achieving (or attempting to achieve) and characterizes how or to what extent each outcome is being achieved.

facts.text: A Target Profile specifies desired outcomes selected and prioritized to achieve cybersecurity risk management objectives.

evidence.quote: A Target Profile specifies the desired outcomes that an organization has selected and prioritized for achieving its cybersecurity risk management objectives.

CSF Target Profile A part of an Organizational Profile that specifies the desired Core outcomes that an organization has selected and prioritized for achieving its cybersecurity risk management objectives.
